name: weak_not_strict_dominance
provenance: Hand-built matrix for MATH-13 (docs/ASCENSION_TRIALS_KIRO_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC_V1_1.md §15 MATH-13): a matrix containing a weakly-but-not-strictly dominated strategy so that true strict elimination (strict '>' in EVERY column) retains it, while the weak-dominance diagnostic ('>=' everywhere with at least one strict) flags it. Row payoff matrix M = [[1,1],[1,0]] (row player's win utility). Row r1 is weakly dominated by r0 (1>=1, 1>=0, strict only in the second column) but not strictly; symmetrically column c0 is weakly dominated by c1 for the minimizing column player. The oracle (survivors + the weak relations) is derived by hand from the matrix definition, not reverse-engineered from engine output (REQ-9.4).
